plan.trigger: Only if Nifty trades below S1 15019
plan.stop: Exit if Nifty rises above Pivot 15057

backtest.note: Technical rules only (no historical option-chain data)

playbook.headline: Leaning bearish. Watch S1 15,019: the put plan starts below it.

watch.name: 200-day average
watch.why: Long-term trend line that large funds watch.

watch.name: 50-day average
watch.why: Medium-term trend line. Closing above or below it shifts the bias.

watch.name: Call-OI wall
watch.why: Most call writers sit here. It tends to cap rallies; a clean break can trigger a fast short-covering move.

watch.name: R2
watch.why: Call target and strong resistance. Book profits on calls here.

watch.name: R1
watch.why: First resistance. Rallies often stall here.

watch.name: Max pain
watch.why: Where option buyers lose the most at expiry (24-Nov-2026). Nifty often drifts toward it close to expiry.

watch.name: Last session high
watch.why: A break above often brings follow-through buying.

watch.name: Pivot
watch.why: Stop-loss line for both plans. Above it buyers control the day, below it sellers do.

watch.name: Put-OI wall
watch.why: Most put writers sit here. It tends to hold dips; a break can speed up a fall.

watch.name: S1
watch.why: Put trigger. A 15-minute close below this starts the PE plan.

watch.name: Last session low
watch.why: A break below often brings follow-through selling.

watch.name: S2
watch.why: Put target and strong support. Book profits on puts here.

scenarios.when: Nifty closes a 15-minute candle above R1 15,121
scenarios.then: Buy an ATM call. Target R2 15,158, exit if Nifty falls back below the pivot 15,057. This goes against today's bias, so trade smaller or skip it.

scenarios.when: Nifty closes a 15-minute candle below S1 15,019
scenarios.then: Buy an ATM put. Target S2 14,956, exit if Nifty climbs back above the pivot 15,057.

scenarios.when: Nifty stays between S1 15,019 and R1 15,121
scenarios.then: Don't buy options. Premiums lose value every hour in a sideways market.

scenarios.when: Nifty opens more than 75 points (0.5%) away from 15,083
scenarios.then: Wait 15 to 30 minutes. Big gaps often partly fill. Enter only if price holds beyond the first 15-minute high (gap up) or low (gap down).

scenarios.when: Price is within 0.5% of the put-OI wall 15,050
scenarios.then: Expect a fight at this level. Wait for a clear 15-minute close through it before trading the breakout.

alerts.title: Put-OI wall at 15,050 is just 33 points below
alerts.detail: Put writers will defend 15,050. If Nifty closes below it, the fall can speed up.

alerts.title: Gap down of 178 points at the open
alerts.detail: The gap zone is 15,046 to 15,224. It is still open, so 15,224 may act as a magnet or as resistance.
